# CyUI components used by CyUrium

CyUI source snapshot, taken on 2026-10-31.
Only the theme and widget sources, their required headers and the original MIT
license are included. The upstream library and its Dear ImGui copy are unchanged.

CyUrium supplies its own browser palette and layout. It uses CyUI for semantic
theme application, DPI scaling and setting controls. Vector browser icons avoid
a dependency on the Windows-only Segoe MDL2 font.

Original source SHA-256:

- `src/Theme.cpp`: recorded in `snapshot.sha256`
- `src/Widgets.cpp`: recorded in `snapshot.sha256`
